description: Ministry of Defence - Award the Uttama Seva Padakkama for the year 2018
categorisation: This gazette announces military awards (Uttama Seva Padakkama) to Sri Lanka Army officers for the year 2018. This falls under public service recognition and honors within the defense sector, specifically covering service awards and commendations for military personnel. Since it involves public sector service recognition rather than government structural changes, personnel appointments, or specialized categories like land or legal matters, it best fits Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes).
